issues.description: React hydration mismatch errors occurring repeatedly on the auth page. Text content does not match server-rendered HTML, causing the entire root to switch to client rendering.
issues.root_cause: The auth page likely contains dynamic content (e.g., Date, Math.random(), browser-only APIs, or conditional rendering based on window/localStorage) that differs between server-side rendering and client-side hydration. This is a classic SSR/CSR mismatch. Common culprits: using new Date() inline, checking typeof window, or a state value initialized differently on server vs client.

fixes.reason: Placeholder — actual fix depends on source. The real fix is to suppress hydration on dynamic content or wrap browser-only logic in useEffect. See next_action.
